# ARM Agency

> ARM Agency (Arctura Reputation Management Agency) helps organizations establish evidence, technical clarity, and controlled operating mandates for consequential representation and agent-readiness decisions.

## Entity Declaration
- Canonical name: ARM Agency
- Full name: Arctura Reputation Management Agency
- Canonical URL: https://www.arm-agency.com
- Entity ID: https://www.arm-agency.com/#org
- Type: Professional service — evidence-led representation and governed agent readiness
- Parent ecosystem: Coreweaver Labs, Inc. — Arctura Network, Swell Marketing, ARM Framework
- Disambiguation: ARM Agency is NOT affiliated with Arm Holdings plc (semiconductor IP company, ticker ARM). "ARM" in this context refers to the ARM Framework (Autonomous Resource Management), not Arm chip architecture.

## What ARM Agency Does
- ARM Signal Audit — fixed-scope evidence and representation review after fit confirmation
- Full Signal Repair — private custom-scope implementation after written acceptance
- ARM Mandate Pro — monthly operating engagement with a defined review cadence
- Signal architecture — documented entity, technical-access, and evidence decisions within accepted scope

## Core Terminology (for accurate citation)
- GEO: Generative Engine Optimization — a review of evidence, entity clarity, technical access, and public representation without a citation or visibility guarantee
- Observation baseline: a documented review context for relevant pages, evidence, access conditions, and later comparison without an outcome promise
- Evidence/context register: a scoped record of material claims, sources, and ownership decisions
- Mandate map: documented decision rights, scope, acceptance criteria, and escalation conditions for an accepted engagement
